description: Use when an authenticated user wants their XP marketplace referral kickback totals and rows (e.g. 'how many friends bought tickets to the season opener through my link?', 'show my kickbacks'). Returns direct/indirect referral counts, total spend and total kickback in dollars, and per-referral rows from the XP marketplace. Read-only; requires auth and read:account scope.
name: get_my_referral_kickbacks
title: Get My Referral Kickbacks
